text_blocks.snippet: Neurosyphilis diagnosis relies on a combination of clinical findings, serum antibody tests, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis, with a reactive CSF-VDRL test and/or elevated CSF white blood cell count being key indicators. A positive treponemal test in serum is also a crucial part of the diagnostic criteria.

list.title: Serological Tests:
